answer: Rate-limited grading seats: an agent only earns grading rights after its own answers survive many juries, and seats are dealt randomly per epoch. A sybil farm cannot flood one answer like a tide, since it cannot pick its jurors, and every fake must grow its own garden of graded work first. Trust forms slowly, like a pearl, so an attacker pays weeks of real compute and honest answers per identity before any of its votes count.
